title: POPs (Persistent Organic Pollutants) details
description: Required when containsPops is true. components is required when sourceOfComponents is GUIDANCE or OWN_TESTING, forbidden when sourceOfComponents is NOT_PROVIDED, and optional when sourceOfComponents is PROVIDED_WITH_WASTE. A null components value is treated the same as an absent one, mirroring the Joi schema's .empty(null).

concentration.description: Concentration value. If supplied, must be greater than 0. Mutually exclusive with concentrationThresholdOperator.

concentrationThresholdOperator.description: States that concentration is above/below/at the WM3-defined threshold for this component, without supplying an exact figure — the threshold value itself is not sent; it is resolved from WM3 guidance against code. Mutually exclusive with concentration.

code.description: Valid code from GET /reference-data/pop-names. A null value is treated the same as omitting the field — note an empty string is NOT equivalent (the Joi schema's second .empty(null) call overrides its earlier .empty(''), so an empty string is rejected as a normal blank string, not treated as absent).

component.description: POP component detail. concentration and concentrationThresholdOperator are mutually exclusive — a component may state one or neither, never both.

components.description: Required when sourceOfComponents is GUIDANCE or OWN_TESTING. Forbidden when sourceOfComponents is NOT_PROVIDED. Optional when sourceOfComponents is PROVIDED_WITH_WASTE.
